name: How can I prevent mold from returning behind drywall after remediation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold from returning behind drywall after remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold recurrence behind drywall primarily involves controlling moisture. After remediation, ensure that the original moisture source, such as a leak or condensation issue, has been fully repaired and is no longer a problem. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% using dehumidifiers or proper ventilation, especially in moisture-prone areas like bathrooms and kitchens. Promptly address any new leaks, spills, or water intrusion, and ensure adequate airflow within your home to prevent moisture buildup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by fixing all moisture sources, maintaining indoor humidity below 60%, ensuring good ventilation, and promptly addressing any new leaks or water damage.
